acoustid.credentials.title: AcoustID credentials
acoustid.credentials.description: API key used to identify songs by audio fingerprint
acoustid.credentials.envHint: Using the key from the server environment. A value stored here would override it.
acoustid.credentials.unreadableHint: The stored key can't be decrypted. This can happen when the encryption key changed or a backup was restored on another host. Re-enter it below.
acoustid.credentials.unreadableHintEnv: The stored key can't be decrypted. This can happen when the encryption key changed or a backup was restored on another host. Re-enter it below. The key from the server environment is used meanwhile.
acoustid.credentials.noneHint: No AcoustID key is configured, so AcoustID matching is skipped. The Docker images ship a key through ACOUSTID_API_KEY, so this normally only shows outside Docker. Create a free API key at acoustid.org and store it here, or set ACOUSTID_API_KEY on the server.
acoustid.credentials.apiKeyHelper: Create a free API key at acoustid.org and store it here. Leave it blank and save to clear a stored key.
